audit.whatIsWrong: win[2] said Shen while its caption ends 'neither side commits, so it's even'; win[4]/win[5] said Skill/Shen while their captions describe you kiting and bullying him; win[6] said Shen while its caption says 'it nets out even'. win[0] said Skill while the caption describes him chaining you down.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Shen,Shen,Skill,Skill,Kayle,Kayle,Skill and 49.86% over 718 games supports an even close, not a Shen-owned late.
audit.corrected: Chart aligned to the packet in both layers with ratings to match.

audit.why: Level 6, Nashor's, and Shen's Stand United (global, available at 6) are the right spikes; spikes[3] correctly uses 'Anytime 6+'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing anywhere states what Spirit's Refuge actually blocks, even though it is the interaction that decides your damage output.
audit.why: Riot text: attacks that would hit Shen or allies near his spirit blade are blocked. Starfire Spellblade (E) is an on-attack effect riding an auto-attack, so it is blocked with the auto; Radiant Blast (Q) is a spell and goes through. Divine Ascent's ranged autos are still autos and are blocked too.
audit.corrected: Added to spikes[2]: poke the bubble with Q, not with attacks.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere.
audit.why: Shadow Dash is 18/16/14/12/10s and costs 150 mana; Spirit's Refuge is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s. Both are long windows to step into.
audit.corrected: Shadow Dash's 18s and Spirit's Refuge's 16s are now stated as the step-up windows.

edits.before: Your ranged DPS plus E's missing-health shred bully an immobile tank who can't catch you once you're spaced outside taunt range.
edits.after: Ranged DPS and E's missing-health shred bully a tank whose Shadow Dash is 18s at rank 1 — step up the moment it misses.

edits.before: Your Nashor's/AS spike plus E's missing-health shred lets your ranged DPS chunk an immobile tank who can't reach you once you space outside Shadow Dash range.
edits.after: Nashor's plus E's missing-health shred chunk him from range — but Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks, and Starfire rides an attack, so poke the bubble with Q instead.

edits.before: His engage CC. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His taunt-dash, 18s at rank 1 — bait it, then step up and commit.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks, 16s cooldown — walk out, re-engage.

notes: Spirit's Refuge blocks basic attacks only. Starfire Spellblade is an on-attack effect and is eaten with the auto; Radiant Blast is a spell and passes through the zone. Divine Ascent's ranged autos are still autos and are blocked.
